trigger.about: pd.to_numeric(..., errors='coerce') applied directly to an Arrow-backed string column (read_csv(dtype_backend='pyarrow')) without first converting it to StringDtype/object or converting the result to numpy float

summary: pd.to_numeric(errors='coerce') on an ArrowDtype string column turns unparseable values into float NaN instead of a missing value: isna() is False for them and sum() returns nan
